integrity: The infinite proof is an exact two-column base-\(p\) carry argument using Kummer's theorem. The finite verifier is only a replay check and is not used to infer the universal statement.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only the boundary restriction \(m=p+1\). It does not classify least extremal rows for arbitrary \(m\) or alter the published \(a\ge2\) formula.
title: The missing \(a=1\) least extremal row for restricted binomial GCDs
